rules.when: US client AND protected health information (PHI) is involved
rules.also: Every subcontractor/freelancer touching PHI needs a subcontractor BAA before data moves; BAA location/subcontractor terms must allow how AtliQ delivers (Pune).

rules.when: Client in EU/EEA/UK AND personal data is involved
requires: Transfer mechanism to India (e.g. EU SCCs)
rules.also: Subprocessors (agencies/freelancers) touching personal data need matching data-protection terms.

rules.when: A contract says a document is 'attached' / an Annex / Exhibit / Schedule
requires: That document present in the upload or the deal bundle
rules.also: Referenced-but-missing → serious if it governs data, liability or price; otherwise negotiable.

rules.when: An agency or freelancer agreement is linked to a client deal
requires: Confidentiality at least as strict as the client contract
IP in work product assigned to AtliQ when the client contract gives the client ownership
Data-protection terms when the subcontractor touches personal data/PHI

rules.when: Freelancer, employee, recruiter or government agreement uploaded on its own
rules.also: Out of scope as a deal: show a scope message and offer to link it to a client deal.
